title.zh-TW: VS Code 智慧切換開啟分頁，遠端設定即時套用
title.en: VS Code smartly switches open tabs, remote settings apply immediately

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中操作多個分頁與遠端控制時的體驗更加順暢。在歷史工作階段選擇器中點選已在其他分頁開啟的工作階段時，編輯器會直接切換到該分頁，不再重複載入同一份對話。在分頁畫面重新整理期間執行重新命名（Rename）指令，系統現在會確實套用新名稱，不再無聲失效。新開啟工作階段時若自動啟動 Remote Control，歡迎畫面不會再莫名消失。此外，若在分頁剛啟動的當下切換「為所有工作階段啟用 Remote Control」，該設定現在能正確套用到正在初始化的分頁中。⟦好比辦公桌上的文件夾標籤與切換器，翻閱已打開的卷宗會直接引導至該分頁，新開的檔案盒也不會因為剛啟動就漏接全域開關。⟧
body.en: Working across multiple tabs and Remote Control in VS Code is now smoother. Selecting a session from the session history picker that is already open in another tab directly switches to that tab instead of loading the same conversation a second time. Executing the Rename command while a tab view is reloading now reliably applies the new name instead of silently doing nothing. When opening a new session where Remote Control starts automatically, the welcome screen no longer inexplicably disappears. Furthermore, toggling "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" right as a tab is launching now properly applies to the initializing tab. ⟦Like folder tabs and switchers on a desk: looking up an already opened file directs you straight to that tab, and a newly opened file box won't miss the global switch just because it was starting up.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the welcome screen disappearing in a new session when Remote Control turns on automatically
[VSCode] Fixed the session history picker loading a session a second time when it is already open in another tab; it now switches to that tab
[VSCode] Fixed the session tab's Rename command silently doing nothing while the tab's view was reloading; it now always applies
[VSCode] Fixed "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" not applying to a session tab that was still starting when the toggle was flipped

title.zh-TW: 企業統一派發 MCP 外部工具，管理設定檔損毀時拒絕啟動
title.en: Organizations can roll out managed MCP servers, and startup halts if managed config is corrupt

items.original:
Added `managedMcpServers` managed setting: organizations can provide HTTP/SSE MCP servers to every user (same entry shape as `.mcp.json`); entries that name a command to run are skipped
Fixed managed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` being ignored at startup when a policy helper configured by MDM or the managed settings file had already run
Fixed managed settings silently going unenforced when the managed-settings file, a drop-in, the MDM plist, or the HKLM value cannot be parsed: Claude Code now refuses to start and names the source
Changed `allowedMcpServers` to govern only servers users add: a literal `managed-mcp.json` server your allowlist used to filter out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off

title.zh-TW: 無人主機新增授權旗標，需確認操作自動拒絕不卡死
title.en: Unattended hosts get a prompt-suppression flag to auto-deny blocking prompts

body.zh-TW:
⟦無人值守的自動收發室遇到需要本人親簽的掛號信時，會依規定直接退回拒收，其餘免簽包裹則正常放行，絕不讓窗口卡死乾等。⟧針對無人看管的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）伺服器，你可以透過完整指令執行：

```
claude --permission-prompts none
```

這項新旗標專門處理無人主機的自動化流程。只要遇到任何需要跳出對話框請求確認的操作，系統都會自動予以拒絕，而當前生效的權限模式（包含自動模式）則會持續在背後自主決策。當你在伺服器排程或 CI 流程中跑工作階段時，再也不用擔心某個未授權的操作讓整個流程無限期停擺。
body.en:
⟦An automated mailroom, when presented with registered mail needing a physical signature, immediately turns it away while clearing normal parcels through, never letting the counter stall in endless waiting.⟧ For unattended headless servers — environments running without a visible terminal window — you can run the full command:

```
claude --permission-prompts none
```

This flag is built for automated pipelines on unattended machines. Whenever an action would pop up a prompt asking for confirmation, it is automatically denied on the spot, while the active permission mode (including auto mode) continues making decisions in the background. Running scheduled jobs or CI pipelines in a session no longer risks a single unprompted action freezing the entire workflow indefinitely.

items.original: Added `--permission-prompts none` for unattended headless hosts: anything that would prompt is denied automatically while the active permission mode (including auto mode) keeps deciding

title.zh-TW: GitLab 合併請求即時標記，終端機狀態列徽章同步更新
title.en: GitLab merge requests are recognized natively with footer badge refreshes

body.zh-TW: 當你在 GitLab 專案中透過命令列工具管理合併請求時，終端機現在能原生識別 `glab mr create`、`merge`、`close`、`reopen`、`note` 與 `update` 等操作。只要執行這些指令，摺疊的工具摘要就會以 `MR !N` 的格式清楚標記合併請求編號，並同步重新整理顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列徽章。這讓你在命令列追蹤程式碼審查與合併進度時，不必反覆切換瀏覽器頁面確認。⟦這就像快遞追蹤器升級了專用條碼辨識，一刷到特定貨號就印出專屬標籤，並即時更新在收件單最底部的狀態欄位。⟧
body.en: When you manage merge requests in GitLab repositories via the command line, the terminal now natively recognizes commands like `glab mr create`, `merge`, `close`, `reopen`, `note`, and `update`. Running these commands formats the merge request number as `MR !N` inside the collapsed tool summary and immediately refreshes the footer MR badge. This allows you to track code review and merge progress from the command line without switching back and forth to your browser. ⟦It is like a parcel scanner getting upgraded barcode logic: the moment a specific tracking code is scanned, a dedicated label prints out and the bottom status bar on the receipt updates in real time.⟧

items.original: Added recognition of `glab mr create/merge/close/reopen/note/update` so GitLab merge requests show as `MR !N` in the collapsed tool summary and refresh the footer MR badge

title.zh-TW: GitLab 專案誤用 GitHub 安裝指令時，主動指引替代文件
title.en: Running the GitHub App installer inside GitLab repos now points to GitLab CI docs

body.zh-TW: 在 GitLab 儲存庫內執行 `/install-github-app` 指令時，終端機不會再默默發送無效請求或顯示不明錯誤。系統現在會主動向你說明該指令僅限 GitHub 專案使用，並直接附上 GitLab CI/CD 官方文件連結指引你如何設定自動化流程。這讓跨平台開發的團隊在摸索指令時，能第一時間獲得正確的替代方案與設定說明。⟦這好比在捷運售票機前詢問高鐵時刻表，系統會明確提醒此處僅販售捷運票券，並主動列出前往高鐵轉乘網頁的指引地圖。⟧
body.en: Running `/install-github-app` inside a GitLab repository no longer fails silently with invalid requests or vague errors. The output now clearly explains that the command is GitHub-only and directly links to the official GitLab CI/CD documentation for setting up your automation pipeline. This provides cross-platform engineering teams with the right alternative steps and configuration guidance right away. ⟦It is like asking a metro ticketing machine for high-speed rail schedules: it politely informs you that it only sells subway tickets, while displaying a map guiding you to the high-speed rail transfer portal.⟧

items.original: Improved `/install-github-app` to explain it is GitHub-only and point to the GitLab CI/CD docs when run inside a GitLab repository

title.zh-TW: Bash 讀取拒絕規則全面收緊，防堵隱藏檔案路徑漏洞
title.en: Bash Read deny rules tighten around option values, git operands, and chained commands

body.zh-TW: ⟦大樓安檢門升級了深層透視，無論違禁品藏在夾層暗袋、寫在包裹參數裡，還是混在大箱貨物中整批搬運，警衛都能確實攔截並要求逐項檢查。⟧過去 Bash 的 `Read()` 檔案讀取拒絕規則存在安全漏洞。如果把敏感檔案放在參數值（例如 `--ignore-revs-file=.env`、`-f.env` 或 `@file`）、作為 `git diff` 與 `git grep` 的檔案操作對象，或是組裝成 `cd DIR && cat FILE` 複合指令，系統曾會漏抓；現在這些途徑全數納入攔截範圍。此外，當你對含有被拒檔案的資料夾執行 `grep -r` 或 `cp -r` 時，系統現在也會主動跳出授權詢問。
body.en: ⟦Building security scanners have been upgraded with deeper inspection: whether contraband is hidden inside secret pockets, written into parcel metadata, or packed into crates for bulk shipping, guards catch it and request manual verification.⟧ Bash `Read()` deny rules previously had loopholes when handling hidden file paths. Passing denied files as option values (such as `--ignore-revs-file=.env`, `-f.env`, or `@file`), as file operands in `git diff` and `git grep`, or chained in compound commands like `cd DIR && cat FILE` previously slipped past security checks; all of these paths are now strictly intercepted. Furthermore, running `grep -r` or `cp -r` over a directory containing a denied file now explicitly prompts for permission.

items.original: Fixed Bash `Read()` deny rules not covering files given as option values (`--ignore-revs-file=.env`, `-f.env`, `@file`), `git diff`/`git grep` file operands, or `cd DIR && cat FILE` compounds; `grep -r`/`cp -r` over a directory holding a denied file now asks

title.zh-TW: 自訂掛鉤建立工作樹時，相容非標準 Git 探測回傳訊息
title.en: Worktree isolation accommodates non-standard git probe messages from hook-created trees

body.zh-TW: 在啟用工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離環境時，由自動化流程建立的平行工作區現在相容性更佳。若你的專案透過掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）自動新增工作樹，過去在部分作業環境中，當底層 `git rev-parse` 探測指令回傳了「not a git repository」以外的自訂錯誤訊息時，系統會誤判而拒絕載入；現在這項異常判斷已修正，確保平行工作區能順暢運作。⟦這如同實驗室的隔離操作箱，只要安全閥是由合格管線自動帶起，即使檢驗儀表回傳了罕見的代碼，門禁系統也不會把合法的操作台鎖死在門外。⟧
body.en: When running with worktree isolation — the Git feature that lets you maintain multiple parallel checkouts of the same project — parallel working copies created by automation pipelines now enjoy broader compatibility. If your project provisions worktrees automatically via hooks (scripts triggered when specific lifecycle events occur), certain environments where underlying `git rev-parse` probe calls failed with messages other than "not a git repository" previously caused Claude Code to misjudge and reject the directory. This probe handling has been fixed so hook-created isolated workspaces load smoothly. ⟦It is like an airtight laboratory chamber: as long as safety valves are engaged through certified lines, an unusual status code on a secondary gauge will not trigger a lockdown that locks the entire workstation out.⟧

items.original: Fixed worktree isolation refusing hook-created worktrees on machines where `git rev-parse` fails with a message other than "not a git repository"

title.zh-TW: 工作樹隔離放寬管線指令，未觸及主目錄操作不再遭拒
title.en: Worktree isolation relaxes checks on pipelines and launcher scripts outside the main repo

body.zh-TW: ⟦這好比保稅倉庫裡理貨，只要貨物確認不會越界流入海關外的主倉庫，內部無論怎麼分裝、繞路搬運，都不會被拉起警報攔下。⟧在工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離環境下執行命令時，檢查限制獲得了合理放寬。以往在隔離工作階段中執行常見的 Bash 迴圈、`xargs` 管線指令，或是透過啟動器包裝的命令時，系統容易過度防衛而直接拒絕執行；現在只要確認這些指令無法碰觸到主儲存庫目錄，系統便會允許正常執行，不再阻礙日常的批次自動化處理。
body.en: ⟦It is like sorting packages inside a bonded warehouse: as long as items cannot cross over into the main customs area outside, any internal repackaging or routing proceeds without setting off security alarms.⟧ Command execution constraints under worktree isolation — which creates isolated duplicate copies of a repository — have been reasonably relaxed. Previously, running common Bash loops, `xargs` pipelines, or wrapper commands from launcher scripts inside isolated sessions was overly restricted and rejected. As long as these commands cannot reach the main checkout directory, they are now permitted to run freely, streamlining routine automated batch workflows.

items.original: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions refusing common Bash loops, xargs pipelines and launcher-wrapped commands that cannot reach the main checkout

title.zh-TW: 多工作階段並行不覆蓋設定，重啟對話與專案辨識更穩定
title.en: Concurrent sessions no longer overwrite settings, improving resumes and repo detection

body.zh-TW: 同時開啟多個工作階段（session，對話工作階段）時，各視窗不再於背景悄悄還原彼此對全域設定檔 `~/.claude.json` 的修改，工作區信任、MCP 與專案狀態再也不會因為並行運作而遺失。此外，若已儲存的紀錄中含有缺少酬載的附件資料，以前執行 `--resume` 會失敗且執行 `--continue` 會開啟空白對話，現在皆能順利接續；儲存庫辨識機制不再因短暫的 Git 探測失敗而丟失身分；claude.ai 使用者的背景 GitHub 連線檢查結果也會跨次啟動妥善記住。⟦這好比多位助理共用同一個公事包，每個人寫入自己的進度時不再覆蓋別人的紀錄，即便翻到空白便條或遇到網路瞬斷，也能迅速認出專案並接續辦公。⟧
body.en: Running multiple sessions at once no longer causes background processes to silently revert each other's updates to `~/.claude.json`, protecting workspace trust, MCP servers, and project state from getting lost during concurrency. Furthermore, `--resume` no longer crashes and `--continue` no longer opens a blank chat when a saved session contains an attachment missing its payload; repository detection will not drop a known repo identity after a transient git probe failure; and background GitHub connection checks for claude.ai users are now remembered across app restarts. ⟦It is like multiple assistants sharing a single briefcase: writing updates no longer erases each other's notes, and finding an empty sheet or hitting a temporary network glitch will not wipe project details from memory.⟧

items.original:
Fixed concurrent sessions silently reverting each other's `~/.claude.json` changes — workspace trust no longer resets and MCP/project state is no longer lost when running many sessions at once
Fixed `--resume` failing (and `--continue` opening an empty conversation) when a saved session contains an attachment entry with no payload
Fixed repository detection dropping a known repo identity after a transient git probe failure
Fixed a background GitHub connection check that ran on every launch for claude.ai users; the result is now remembered across launches

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控確實中止背景代理，工作流程結果彩色排版
title.en: Remote control stops background agents reliably, and workflow outputs gain syntax coloring

body.zh-TW: 在遠端遙控的工作階段中按下停止時，背景代理與工作流程現在會確實終止，已被中斷的任務在行程完全結束前會維持可見且允許再次停止；在前次中斷尚未結束前恢復工作流程，也不會再意外跑出重複的代理。當暫停中的遠端或排程工作階段核准了連接器工具的授權請求後，系統會正確接續運作。檢視 `/workflows` 的代理詳細資訊時，JSON 結果會以語法上色與換行整齊美化，過長內容亦會收合在展開按鈕後；巢狀背景子代理的成果也會保存於母代理紀錄中。⟦控制中心調度自動化車隊時，按下緊急煞車便能確實停下車輛且儀表持續監控，重新出發不會誤發兩輛相同班車，行車紀錄也用彩色列印整齊歸檔。⟧
body.en: Hitting Stop in remote-control sessions now reliably terminates background agents and workflows, keeping killed tasks visible and stoppable until their underlying processes completely exit. Resuming a workflow while a previously stopped run is still exiting no longer spawns duplicate agent instances. When a paused remote or scheduled session approves a connector tool permission prompt, execution resumes smoothly. Under `/workflows`, agent detail views now pretty-print JSON results with syntax highlighting and line breaks, tucking lengthy outputs behind an expand toggle, while nested background subagent results are retained inside parent transcripts. ⟦When a dispatch center manages autonomous fleets, hitting the emergency brake brings every vehicle to a full halt under live monitoring, resuming never dispatches duplicate vehicles, and logs are cleanly archived in color.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Stop not actually stopping background agents and workflows in remote-control sessions: killed tasks now stay visible and re-stoppable until their processes exit
Fixed resuming a workflow run while its previous stopped run was still exiting, which could run duplicate copies of its agents
Improved `/workflows` agent detail: JSON outcomes are pretty-printed with syntax colors and real line breaks, and long outcomes fold behind an expand toggle
Improved nested background subagent results to be saved in the parent subagent's transcript, so resumed subagents keep them and shared transcripts show the delivery
Fixed remote and scheduled sessions doing nothing after a connector-tool permission prompt was approved while the session was paused

title.zh-TW: 自訂指令支援指定模型，Vertex 代碼正確套用長度上限
title.en: Custom commands support frontmatter models, and Vertex IDs respect token context caps

body.zh-TW: 你在自訂指令與技能檔頭指定的 `model:` 設定，在互動式工作階段中現在會如實生效。在自動模式下若遇到不支援的模型，系統則會穩定保留當前工作階段的模型繼續執行，避免任務意外中斷。此外，針對帶有 `@YYYYMMDD` 日期後綴的 Vertex 格式模型代碼，即便屬於系統尚未內建識別的模型版本，環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` 所設定的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限如今也能正確生效。⟦這就像專業派工系統指派技師，手動點名特定專長時必定指派專人，遇到不支援的工法時則維持原班人馬，且對每位專家的工作備忘錄長度都嚴格設限。⟧
body.en: Frontmatter `model:` declarations inside custom commands and skills now apply properly in interactive sessions. When running in auto mode, requesting a model that is not supported will retain the current session's model instead of breaking the turn. Furthermore, `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` now respects Vertex-style model IDs carrying `@YYYYMMDD` date suffixes, even for version tags that Claude Code does not natively recognize out of the box. ⟦It is like a specialist dispatch system: requesting a specific technician assigns them directly, encountering an unsupported craft keeps the original crew, and every expert is held to strict limits on briefing notes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed auto mode running a turn on a model it doesn't support when a command or skill's frontmatter `model:` named one; the turn now keeps the session model
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` being ignored for Vertex-style model IDs (`@YYYYMMDD` suffix) of model versions Claude Code doesn't recognize
Fixed frontmatter `model:` on custom commands and skills being ignored in interactive sessions

title.zh-TW: 思考歷程不再重複被拒，提示快取遇權杖更新妥善留存
title.en: Thinking processes are not rejected repeatedly, and prompt caches persist across token refreshes

body.zh-TW: ⟦考場草稿紙在更換識別證或被監考官暫停時，考生先前的推導算式與記憶紀錄依然完整保留，不會在下一題全部被迫重算。⟧在對話過程中若模型的思考歷程曾遭拒絕一次，後續輪次不會再陷入重複被拒的窘境。在關閉遙測的工作階段中，更新 OAuth 授權令牌時，也不會意外清除提示詞快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）。此外，觸發阻擋型 Stop 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）後，下一輪對話依然能完整保留上一輪的思考推導脈絡，避免在特定模型上發生快取未命中而重複計算的情況。
body.en: ⟦Like scrap paper in an examination hall: when your badge is renewed or a proctor pauses the clock, your prior formulas and reasoning remain intact on the desk rather than being wiped clean before the next question.⟧ If a model's thinking reasoning is rejected during a conversation, subsequent turns will no longer be repeatedly rejected in a loop. In sessions with telemetry disabled, refreshing an OAuth token no longer unexpectedly invalidates the prompt cache. In addition, triggering a blocking Stop hook preserves the previous turn's reasoning and prevents prompt cache misses on supported models.

items.original:
Fixed a conversation whose thinking was rejected once being rejected again on every later turn
Fixed the prompt cache being invalidated when the OAuth token refreshed in sessions with telemetry disabled
Fixed blocking Stop hooks causing the turn after a block to lose the model's reasoning from that turn and, on some models, miss the prompt cache

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器離線即時報錯，連線就緒後啟動加速五十毫秒
title.en: MCP server disconnects report errors immediately, and session starts speed up by 50 ms

body.zh-TW: 啟動時若有 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器在列出工具清單的過程中斷線，系統現在會明確回報錯誤訊息，不再顯示為已連線卻有零個工具。在 claude.ai 遠端工作階段中，若瀏覽器端託管的伺服器分頁已關閉，系統也不會再讓你在每輪對話開頭枯等 60 秒。同時，在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）與 SDK 工作階段啟動時，只要工具伺服器連線完畢，第一輪對話最多能提早 50 毫秒開始執行。⟦點餐系統連線外送廚房時，廚房若斷線會立刻通報故障而非顯示零道菜，離線分店也不會拖累點餐進度，連線就緒後出單速度更提升了 50 毫秒。⟧
body.en: When an MCP server (Model Context Protocol, which connects AI to external tools) disconnects while enumerating available tools at startup, Claude Code now reports the error clearly instead of showing as connected with zero tools. In remote claude.ai sessions, closing a browser-hosted MCP server tab will no longer leave you waiting 60 seconds at the start of each turn. Furthermore, headless and SDK sessions now begin their first turn up to 50 ms sooner once MCP servers finish connecting. ⟦It is like a restaurant ordering system linked to cloud kitchens: if a kitchen goes offline, it immediately alerts staff instead of showing a blank menu, inactive branches will not stall the queue, and orders dispatch 50 ms faster once lines are connected.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers that disconnect while their tools are being listed at startup showing as connected with no tools instead of reporting the error
Fixed remote (claude.ai) sessions taking 60 seconds to start a turn after a browser-hosted MCP server's page had gone away
Improved headless/SDK session start: the first turn begins up to 50 ms sooner when MCP servers finish connecting

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕長對話不留白，終端機畫面量測重複利用加速渲染
title.en: Fullscreen mode avoids blank renders, and text measurement reuse accelerates terminals

body.zh-TW: ⟦演講廳的大型投影幕升級了文字排版引擎，不管內容多長或窗格如何縮放，畫面都不會突然留白，最新字幕與修改細節都能完整映出。⟧當你在全螢幕模式下進行呼叫數百次工具的長篇對話時，畫面不會再發生顯示空白對話的異常；終端機在調整視窗大小或初次渲染長回覆時，也會重複利用文字量測數據以提升流暢度。執行 Shell 指令時的即時預覽，不再因為前段文字自動換行而遮蔽最新輸出的幾行。此外，檔案編輯授權對話框過去偶爾會在無任何提示下截斷變更內容的問題，現在也已修復並完整顯示變更行。
body.en: ⟦An auditorium projector upgraded its typesetting engine: no matter how long the text is or how panes are resized, the display never goes blank, rendering the latest captions and edits clearly.⟧ Engaging in lengthy conversations with hundreds of tool calls in fullscreen mode no longer causes the display to go blank. Resizing the terminal or rendering lengthy responses for the first time now reuses text measurement data to improve rendering performance. Shell command live output previews no longer hide the newest lines when earlier text wraps. Additionally, a bug where the file edit permission dialog occasionally truncated modified lines without warning has been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed fullscreen mode showing a blank conversation after a long turn with hundreds of tool calls
Fixed the live output preview of a running shell command hiding its newest lines when an earlier line wrapped
Fixed the file edit permission dialog sometimes showing a changed line cut short with no indication
Improved terminal resize and first-render performance for long responses by reusing text measurements

title.zh-TW: 外掛檢驗支援結構化報告，補齊雲端指標遺漏的使用者屬性
title.en: Plugin validation supports structured JSON, and cloud metrics restore missing user attributes

body.zh-TW: 在擴充套件與監控整合方面，執行 `claude plugin validate --json` 現在可產出供程式解析的結構化檢驗報告。在安裝擴充套件時，帶有結尾斜線或尾隨 `?` 與 `#` 的 GitHub 市集網址，現在也能正確解析出可用的 `.git` 複製位址。從舊版本接續下來的工作階段發布 Artifact 產物時，不會再因「unexpected parameter `note`」錯誤而失敗一次。此外，雲端工作階段發出的 OpenTelemetry 指標與事件，也已補回過去遺漏的 `user.email`、`organization.id` 與 `user.account_uuid` 三項識別屬性。⟦這就像品管檢驗站引進了結構化資料匯出功能，無論貨物標籤帶有尾隨雜訊還是系統接續舊單，都能精準解析並附上完整的客戶與組織識別資訊。⟧
body.en: In plugin tooling and observability integrations, running `claude plugin validate --json` now outputs a machine-readable JSON validation report. When installing plugins, GitHub marketplace URLs containing trailing slashes or dangling `?` and `#` fragments now correctly resolve to usable `.git` clone URLs. Publishing Artifacts in sessions continued from older versions no longer fails on an "unexpected parameter `note`" error. In addition, OpenTelemetry metrics and events emitted from cloud sessions now restore the previously missing `user.email`, `organization.id`, and `user.account_uuid` attributes. ⟦It is like a quality inspection checkpoint introducing structured data exports: whether parcel labels carry trailing smudges or system handovers resume from older tickets, everything is parsed and tagged with client and organization metadata.⟧

items.original:
Added `--json` to `claude plugin validate` for a machine-readable validation report
Fixed Artifact publishing failing once with an "unexpected parameter `note`" error in conversations continued from an older version
Fixed OpenTelemetry metrics and events from cloud sessions missing the `user.email`, `organization.id`, and `user.account_uuid` attributes
Fixed marketplace repo URLs on github.com with a trailing slash or dangling `?`/`#` producing an unusable `.git` clone URL

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 側邊欄新增快捷篩選，工作階段按狀態精準分類
title.en: [VSCode] Active quick filter and status menu added to session sidebar

body.zh-TW: ⟦在收件匣頂端新增快捷分類標籤後，只要點選處理中或待回覆就能立刻過濾郵件，不必在落落長的清單中逐筆翻找。⟧VS Code 擴充套件的側邊欄工作階段（session，對話工作階段）清單迎來了篩選功能升級。側邊欄新增了 `Active` 快捷過濾按鈕，能快速篩出進行中的項目；同時加入了狀態篩選選單，提供等待使用者輸入的 `Needs input`、執行中的 `Working` 以及已完成的 `Completed` 等分類選項。這讓你在同時管理多個任務時，能迅速定位需要立即處理的對話。
body.en: ⟦Adding quick filter tabs to the top of an inbox lets you instantly isolate ongoing or pending threads without scrolling through endless rows.⟧ The VS Code extension's session list sidebar now features upgraded filtering controls. A new `Active` quick filter button lets you instantly view ongoing sessions, alongside a dedicated status filter menu offering categories like `Needs input` (waiting for user response), `Working` (in progress), and `Completed`. This helps you quickly zero in on conversations requiring immediate attention when juggling multiple tasks.

items.original: [VSCode] Added an Active quick filter and a status filter menu (Needs input, Working, Completed) to the session list sidebar

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 路由選單加入 GPT-6-Astra 模型
title.en: Amazon Bedrock Route Picker Adds GPT-6-Astra Model

body.zh-TW: 你在 Amazon Bedrock 雲端環境中調用 Codex 時，挑選模型有了新選項。⟦如同連鎖餐廳在特定分店的點餐機上，正式把最新招牌菜加入螢幕選單，走進指定門市的顧客直接按螢幕就能點選。⟧這項改動涵蓋 Mantle 路由，以及 Runtime 的 global 與 US 路由（route，雲端服務分配請求路徑的通道）。只要連線走這幾條途徑，你就能在模型挑選器（model picker，供手動切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中直接選取 GPT-6-Astra 模型。走 Mantle 或 Runtime 的 global／US 路由時，可在模型挑選器直接選 GPT-6-Astra。
body.en: When calling Codex in the Amazon Bedrock cloud environment, you now have a new option when selecting models. ⟦Much like a chain restaurant officially adding its latest signature dish to the screen menu on ordering kiosks at specific branches, allowing customers entering designated stores to select it directly on the screen.⟧ This change covers the Mantle route as well as Runtime's global and US routes. As long as your connection uses these paths, you can directly select the GPT-6-Astra model in the model picker. When routing through Mantle or Runtime global/US, you can directly choose GPT-6-Astra in the model picker.

items.original: Added GPT-6-Astra to the Amazon Bedrock model picker for Mantle and Runtime global/US routes. (#42805)

title.zh-TW: 修正 GPT-6-Astra 非同步提問指引，改用支援工具且認得純文字限制
title.en: Corrected GPT-6-Astra Guidance for Asynchronous Clarifications to Use Supported Tools and Recognize Text-Only Limits

body.zh-TW: 交給 GPT-6-Astra 的任務如果需求不明確，它在背景發問釐清的流程現在更穩定。這項改動修正了該模型提出非同步釐清問題（asynchronous clarification questions，不中斷手邊工作、在背景等候回覆的提問機制）時的內建指引。現在它會確實呼叫官方受支援的工具（supported tool，環境中明訂可用來向外部發問的功能模組），不再誤用不相容的管道。同時，它也能正確辨識該工具僅接受純文字內容，避免送出不支援的格式而引發錯誤。⟦宛如助理遇到交代不清的待辦事項時，會準確把疑問寫成便條紙投進專用留言箱，不再投錯信箱或塞進格式不符的包裹。⟧
body.en: When tasks assigned to GPT-6-Astra have unclear requirements, its process for asking clarifying questions in the background is now more reliable. This change corrects the model's built-in guidance when asking asynchronous clarification questions. It now properly calls officially supported tools instead of misusing incompatible channels. At the same time, it correctly recognizes that the tool accepts only plain text, avoiding errors caused by sending unsupported formats. ⟦Much like an assistant dealing with an unclearly explained task who accurately writes questions on a memo note and drops it into a dedicated message box, rather than dropping it into the wrong mailbox or stuffing in a parcel with an incompatible format.⟧

items.original: Corrected GPT-6-Astra’s guidance for asynchronous clarification questions to use the supported tool and recognize that it accepts text only. (#42809)

title.zh-TW: 更正 GPT-6-Astra Fast 方案描述，文字標明 2 倍速度與更高用量
title.en: Correct GPT-6-Astra Fast tier description to state 2x speed and increased usage

body.zh-TW: 你在挑選模型方案時，會發現 GPT-6-Astra Fast 等級的說明文字有了修正。現在介面會明確標示為「 2x speed, increased usage 」（ 2 倍速度並提高使用量），取代先前寫著的 1.5 倍標示。這項改動純粹是介面文字顯示的勘誤，背後實際發送請求與模型運作的方式維持原樣，執行效能並沒有任何改變。⟦好比快遞門市把海報上的特快配送標籤從 1.5 倍更正為 2 倍，車隊的送貨路線與行車速度始終如一，只是把印錯的宣傳字樣換成正確內容。⟧因此看到介面數字調整時無需擔心，所有指令與請求依然維持既有方式正常運作。
body.en: When selecting model tiers, you will notice an updated description for the GPT-6-Astra Fast tier. The interface now clearly displays "2x speed, increased usage" instead of the previous "1.5x" label. This update is strictly a correction to the displayed text; how requests are sent and how the model operates behind the scenes remain identical, with no change to runtime performance. ⟦It is like a courier branch correcting a poster label for express delivery from 1.5x to 2x; the fleet's delivery routes and driving speeds remain unchanged, simply replacing the misprinted promotional wording with the accurate text.⟧ Therefore, there is no need for concern when seeing the adjusted numbers in the interface, as all commands and requests continue to function normally as before.

items.original: Corrected the GPT-6-Astra Fast tier description to say “2x speed, increased usage” instead of “1.5x.” This changes only the displayed text, not how requests run. (#42632)

title.zh-TW: API 支援指定 GPT-6-Astra，不改預設也不進選單
title.en: Support specifying GPT-6-Astra via API without changing defaults or appearing in the picker

body.zh-TW: 如果你透過 API 串接 Codex 跑程式，現在可以直接在呼叫時指定使用 GPT-6-Astra 模型。它既不會動到你日常使用的預設模型，也不會出現在模型挑選器（model picker，供手動切換模型的選單）裡面。這讓需要特定模型的後端腳本能順利運作，一般在介面挑模型的人看不到這個選項。⟦這就像餐廳為外燴訂單開放私房菜色，廚房能照單出菜，但大廳的常態菜單與櫃檯點餐看板依然維持原樣，不必擔心常客點餐時眼花。⟧
body.en: If you connect to Codex via API to run code, you can now specify the GPT-6-Astra model directly in your API calls. It will neither modify your everyday default model nor appear in the model picker (the menu for manually switching models). This allows backend scripts requiring a specific model to run smoothly without exposing the option to users selecting models in the interface. ⟦It is like a restaurant offering off-menu specialties exclusively for catering orders: the kitchen prepares them as requested, while the dining hall's regular menu and ordering board remain unchanged, preventing regular diners from getting confused when ordering.⟧

items.original: Added support for configuring GPT-6-Astra through the API without changing the default model or showing it in the model picker. (#42605)

title.zh-TW: 產物檢視器支援快速翻半頁，Mermaid 流程圖終端圖表更清晰
title.en: Artifact viewer adds half-page scrolling, clearer terminal Mermaid flowcharts

body.zh-TW: 閱讀 AI 產出的長篇架構文件或分析報告時，畫面瀏覽與圖表呈現變得更加流暢。⟦猶如在終端機裡翻閱長篇樂譜，以前只能一行行微調捲動，現在輕按按鍵就能一次翻過半面樂譜，頁面上的流程箭頭與架構符號也排版得井然有序。⟧在產物檢視器（artifact viewer，檢視 AI 產生之獨立檔案的瀏覽視窗）中，現在支援按下 `Ctrl+D` 向下翻動半頁與 `Ctrl+U` 向上翻動半頁。同時，在對話紀錄與產物檢視器裡繪製 Mermaid 流程圖時，系統改進了終端機 ASCII 純文字圖表的渲染排版，讓方塊節點與連線更整齊易讀。
body.en: Reading long architecture documents or analysis reports generated by AI is now smoother with clearer diagrams. ⟦Like flipping through a long sheet music score in a terminal where you previously had to scroll line by line, you can now turn half a page with a single keypress, while process arrows and structural symbols stay neatly aligned.⟧ The artifact viewer (a browsing window for inspecting standalone files generated by AI) now supports pressing `Ctrl+D` to scroll down half a page and `Ctrl+U` to scroll up half a page. Meanwhile, when rendering Mermaid flowcharts in conversation history and the artifact viewer, the system improves terminal ASCII plain-text diagram layouts, making box nodes and connecting lines cleaner and easier to read.

items.original:
Added half-page scrolling with `Ctrl+D` and `Ctrl+U` to the artifact viewer.
Improved terminal ASCII diagram rendering for Mermaid flowcharts in the artifact viewer and conversation.

title.zh-TW: `/resume` 新增 `pickerGrouping` 設定，自由指定歷史對話預設檢視
title.en: `/resume` adds `pickerGrouping` setting to customize default conversation list view

body.zh-TW:
每次使用 `/resume` 挑選歷史對話時，現在可以依照個人偏好鎖定預設的呈現清單。⟦就像在氣象 App 裡把預設城市鎖定成台北——每次開啟就直接顯示台北的天氣頁面，不必重選；要切換成依地區分組或平鋪全部城市，只要調一次設定，日後開啟自動套用。⟧系統在 `/config` 指令與 `settings.json` 設定檔中新增了 `pickerGrouping` 設定項目。你可以將其設定為依工作區分組或是平鋪清單（flat），讓對話挑選介面一開啟就呈現你習慣的版面結構：

```
{
  "pickerGrouping": "workspace"
}
```

可在設定檔中指定為 workspace 或 flat。
body.en:
When using `/resume` to pick past conversations, you can now lock in a default list view based on personal preference. ⟦Like setting your weather app's default city to Taipei so opening the app immediately shows Taipei's weather without having to reselect, switching to grouping by region or showing all cities flat requires just one setting tweak and applies automatically thereafter.⟧ The system adds the `pickerGrouping` setting to the `/config` command and `settings.json` configuration file. You can configure it to group by workspace or display a flat list, ensuring the conversation picker opens in your preferred layout:

```
{
  "pickerGrouping": "workspace"
}
```

It can be set to workspace or flat in the configuration file.

items.original: Added the `pickerGrouping` setting to `/config` and `settings.json` to configure the default conversation list view in `/resume` (flat or grouped by workspace).

title.zh-TW: `/model` 選單未指定模型預設思考力度，由低檔提升為中檔
title.en: Unselected model families in `/model` picker now default to medium reasoning effort instead of low

body.zh-TW: 在終端機使用 `/model` 挑選模型時，未特別手動指定思考深度的模型家族現在會主動投入更多推理思考。過去在互動式選單中切換模型時，未經額外設定的模型預設會採用 low（低推理努力程度）。現在預設檔位全面調整為 medium（中等推理努力程度），讓模型在處理程式碼或分析架構時進行更周全的推導。⟦就像把電風扇的預設風速從低速換成中速——插上電一啟動就直接在中速運轉，不必每次手動往上撥到慣用的檔位。⟧
body.en: When selecting models via `/model` in the terminal, model families without an explicitly specified thinking depth now proactively invest more reasoning effort. Previously, when switching models in the interactive picker, models without extra configuration defaulted to low reasoning effort. The default level has now been updated to medium reasoning effort, enabling models to perform more thorough reasoning when writing code or analyzing architecture. ⟦Like changing an electric fan's default speed from low to medium—powering it on immediately runs at medium speed without needing to manually toggle up to your preferred setting every time.⟧

items.original: Changed unselected model families in the interactive `/model` picker to default to medium reasoning effort instead of low.

title.zh-TW: 子代理全自動執行不再誤停，開啟詳細面板不跳授權詢問
title.en: Subagents stay fully automated without stopping when opening details panel in always-proceed mode

body.zh-TW: 放手讓子代理獨立執行任務時，查看即時進度不再意外打斷自動化流程。在啟用 always-proceed（一律放行，不逐一詢問工具授權的自動執行模式）的狀態下，過去使用者只要切換開啟子代理詳細資訊面板，原本在背景順暢運作的子代理任務會突然跳出工具執行確認視窗，中斷原本的連續作業。這項問題已經修復，現在開啟或瀏覽詳細面板時，子代理會維持全自動推進。⟦這好比在全自動洗車機旁透過透明觀景窗查看清洗進度，機械手臂不會因為有人在窗外觀看就突然煞車要求手動確認。⟧
body.en: Checking live progress while letting subagents work autonomously no longer unexpectedly interrupts automated workflows. When running in always-proceed mode (an automatic execution mode that approves tool usage without prompting for each one), opening the subagent details panel previously caused subagent tasks running smoothly in the background to suddenly pop up tool approval prompts, halting continuous operations. This issue has now been resolved, so subagents continue running fully automatically when opening or viewing the details panel. ⟦Like watching a car wash's progress through a transparent observation window, where the robotic arms do not suddenly brake and demand manual confirmation just because someone is looking through the glass.⟧

items.original: Fixed subagent tasks unexpectedly prompting for tool approval in always-proceed mode while viewing the subagent details panel.

title.zh-TW: 終止子代理與刪除對話自動清除孤立工作樹，釋放磁碟空間
title.en: Terminating subagents and deleting conversations now cleans up orphaned Git worktrees to free disk space

body.zh-TW: 結束多代理協作或清理舊對話時，硬碟不再默默累積暫存資料夾。⟦如同工坊在學徒收工或專案結案時，自動將臨時搭建的平行副工作台拆卸清理，不再讓廢棄支架堆滿倉庫角落。⟧系統在呼叫子代理進行平行作業時，會於 `.system_generated/worktrees` 目錄下建立 worktree（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。過去在強制終止子代理或刪除歷史對話時，這些臨時工作樹常未被完全移除而變成孤立殘留檔案。現在清理機制已修正，會在結束時確實移除並釋放磁碟空間。
body.en: Ending multi-agent collaboration or cleaning up old conversations no longer silently accumulates temporary folders on disk. ⟦Like a workshop automatically dismantling and clearing out temporary parallel workstations when apprentices pack up or projects wrap up, preventing discarded frames from piling up in warehouse corners.⟧ When calling subagents for parallel execution, the system creates worktrees (a Git feature that creates multiple parallel copies of the same project) under the `.system_generated/worktrees` directory. Previously, when forcefully terminating subagents or deleting conversation history, these temporary worktrees were often not fully removed, leaving behind orphaned lingering files. The cleanup mechanism is now fixed to reliably remove them upon completion and reclaim disk space.

items.original: Fixed orphaned Git worktrees accumulating on disk under `.system_generated/worktrees` when killing subagents or deleting conversations.

title.zh-TW: 改善登出速度並落盤中繼資料，排除暫存目錄虛假日誌
title.en: Faster `/logout`, metadata flushed to disk on exit, and spurious logs eliminated for temporary directories

body.zh-TW: 在登出帳號、結束指令與載入自訂設定時，底層的狀態處理與儲存機制進行了一批強化。使用 `/logout` 登出時，若系統金鑰圈被繞過或無法連線，系統會直接捷徑刪除檔案中的 token（授權令牌），縮短登出耗費的時間。在離開命令列介面時，系統修復了 SQLite 資料庫的預寫日誌檢查點機制，確保關閉前將最後的工作階段中繼資料完整寫入硬碟。此外，自訂功能探索機制在存取暫存目錄或工作區以外的路徑時，也不會再印出多餘的虛假錯誤日誌。⟦猶如劇院散場後的後台收尾：工作人員先把道具登記入庫，再確認燈控系統完整歸零存檔，最後閘門落鎖，不再對後台外的公共走廊誤觸警報。⟧
body.en: Underlying state handling and persistence mechanisms have received a batch of enhancements during account logout, command exits, and customization loading. When logging out via `/logout`, if the system keyring is bypassed or unreachable, the system now short-circuits token removal directly to file storage, speeding up logout execution. When exiting the command-line interface, the system fixes SQLite database WAL checkpointing to ensure trailing session metadata is fully flushed to disk before shutdown. Furthermore, customization discovery no longer logs spurious errors when accessing temporary directories or paths outside the active workspace. ⟦Like backstage wrap-up after a theater show ends: staff first register props into storage, verify the lighting control system is fully reset and saved, and finally lock the gates without accidentally triggering alarms for public corridors outside the backstage area.⟧

items.original:
Improved `/logout` execution time by short-circuiting token removal directly to file storage when keyring storage is bypassed or unreachable.
Fixed SQLite database WAL checkpointing on CLI exit so trailing session metadata updates are flushed to disk before shutdown.
Fixed customization discovery logging spurious errors when accessing temporary directories or paths outside the active workspace.

title.zh-TW: `/resume` 新增目錄分組檢視，快速鍵切換對話清單更俐落
title.en: `/resume` Adds Directory Grouping View for Toggling Conversation History

body.zh-TW: 你在多個專案資料夾之間切換工作時，要在歷史對話裡找回之前的討論，現在多了更清楚的分類方式。⟦像把抽屜裡混成一疊的文件，按專案資料夾分類收納，只要按一下快速鍵，就能在平鋪清單與活頁夾分組之間自由切換。⟧使用 `/resume` 指令挑選過去的對話時，新增了自由啟用的工作區分組檢視。只要按下 `Ctrl+F` 快速鍵，就能在原本平鋪的對話清單與依目錄分組的檢視之間即時切換，迅速找到特定專案底下的歷史紀錄。
body.en: When switching between multiple project directories, finding past discussions in your conversation history is now much more organized. ⟦It is like sorting a messy pile of documents from a drawer into project folders, letting you switch between a flat list and categorized binders with a single keystroke.⟧ When using the `/resume` command to pick a past conversation, you can now opt into a workspace-grouped view. Simply press `Ctrl+F` to toggle between the flat conversation list and conversations grouped by directory, quickly locating history for a specific project.

items.original: Added an opt-in workspace-grouped view to the `/resume` conversation picker, allowing users to toggle between a flat list and conversations grouped by directory with `Ctrl+F`.

title.zh-TW: 模型目錄收錄 Gemini 3.8 Flash，API 金鑰連線多一項輕快選擇
title.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash Added to Model Catalog for API Key Connections

body.zh-TW: 偏好直接使用官方 API 金鑰連線的開發者，模型清單中迎來了更新的生力軍。⟦這就像在工具箱裡添置了一把高轉速的輕便電動起子，只要插上專用電池，就能隨時拿出來處理講求反應速度與俐落節奏的組裝工作。⟧只要你在環境中設定 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線，模型目錄中就會列出最新的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 模型。在進行日常程式碼查詢或快速編輯時，便能直接在選單中指定此模型，享有更充裕的模型調配彈性。
body.en: Developers who prefer connecting directly with an official API key now have a fresh, responsive option in their model list. ⟦It is like adding a high-speed, lightweight electric screwdriver to your toolbox, ready to tackle assembly tasks requiring fast reactions whenever you plug in its battery.⟧ Once you configure `GEMINI_API_KEY` in your environment, the latest Gemini 3.8 Flash model appears in the model catalog. When performing routine code lookups or quick edits, you can select this model directly from the menu to enjoy greater flexibility.

items.original: Added Gemini 3.8 Flash to the model catalog when connecting with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 自訂代理預設繼承全域資源，開箱即用周遭技能與規則
title.en: Markdown Custom Agents Inherit Ambient Skills, Rules, and Subagents by Default

body.zh-TW: 用 Markdown 檔案撰寫自訂代理時，現在能享有與預設代理完全一致的資源配置。過去自訂代理不會自動承接環境裡現有的各項技能、規則與子代理（subagents，分擔特定任務的輔助代理），讓自訂助理往往少了一整套基本能力；現在自訂代理一律預設繼承周遭的所有技能、規則與子代理，開箱就能直接調用環境資源。⟦這好比新到職的特助走進辦公室，桌上已自動配齊團隊現成的工具箱、作業規範與協力助手名冊，不必凡事從頭自行申請。⟧
body.en: When defining custom agents with Markdown files, they now receive the exact same resource configuration as default agents. Previously, custom agents did not automatically inherit ambient skills, rules, and subagents (specialized auxiliary agents that handle specific tasks), often leaving them without essential capabilities. Now, custom agents inherit all surrounding skills, rules, and subagents by default, ready to use ambient resources out of the box. ⟦It is like a newly hired assistant walking into an office to find the team's standard toolkit, operating guidelines, and directory of helpers already neatly set up on their desk without having to request each one from scratch.⟧

items.original: Changed custom agents defined in Markdown to inherit ambient skills, rules, and subagents by default, matching the configuration of default agents.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Markdown 自訂代理相對路徑解析，以定義檔所在目錄為基準
title.en: Fixed Relative Path Resolution in Markdown Custom Agents Based on Definition Directory

body.zh-TW: 你在自訂代理的 Markdown 定義檔中引用周邊模組時，相對路徑不再因為執行位置不同而迷路。過去在代理定義檔中若使用相對路徑來指定子代理與外掛程式，系統常以當前執行目錄而非定義檔所在位置進行解析，導致檔案找不到；現在相對路徑一律以該代理定義檔所在的資料夾為基準正確解析。⟦這宛如依據建築平面圖找房間，說明書上的「走廊左側第三間」一律以這棟大樓的入口為基準計算，不會因為你站在不同大門外就指錯方位。⟧
body.en: When referencing nearby modules in a custom agent's Markdown definition file, relative paths will no longer get lost depending on where you run the tool. Previously, when specifying subagents and plugins using relative paths in an agent definition, paths were often resolved against the current working directory instead of the definition file's location, causing files to go missing. Relative paths now resolve correctly against the directory containing that agent definition file. ⟦It is like navigating a building floor plan where instructions like "third door on the left" are always measured from that building's main entrance, rather than pointing in the wrong direction because you happen to be standing outside another gate.⟧

items.original: Fixed relative path resolution in Markdown-defined custom agents so relative subagent and plugin paths resolve correctly against the agent definition's directory.

title.zh-TW: MCP OAuth 支援逾千字超長授權碼，身分驗證不再受阻
title.en: MCP OAuth Now Supports Long Authorization Codes Exceeding 1024 Characters

body.zh-TW: 透過外部授權伺服器綁定帳號時，長序號不再卡死登入流程。使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）進行 OAuth 登入驗證時，如果授權伺服器回傳長度超過 1024 個字元的授權碼，過去系統會因長度限制而判定失敗；現在這項門檻限制已經修復，長度超過 1024 字元的授權碼也能順利通過驗證並完成服務連接。⟦如同大樓門禁閘門升級了感應容量，過去訪客通行證條碼超過特定字數就會讀取失敗，現在遇到長條碼也能順暢感應通關。⟧
body.en: When connecting accounts via external authorization servers, lengthy tokens no longer block your sign-in flow. During MCP (Model Context Protocol) OAuth authentication, if an authorization server returned an authorization code longer than 1024 characters, the process previously failed due to a length limitation. This limit has now been fixed, allowing authorization codes exceeding 1024 characters to authenticate successfully and complete the connection. ⟦It is like upgrading an office security gate so that long visitor badge barcodes, which previously triggered scan errors, now scan and grant access without a hitch.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth authentication failing when authorization servers return authorization codes longer than 1024 characters.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 技能面板路徑比對，全域與工作區技能正確歸類
title.en: Fixed Windows Skill Path Matching to Properly Classify Global and Workspace Skills

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上檢視已安裝的擴充技能時，面板清單中的分類與層級變得更加精準。過去在 Windows 環境開啟 `/skills` 面板時，由於主機路徑分隔符號（反斜線 `\`）的比對問題，導致全域技能與工作區技能經常被錯誤分類；現在路徑比對與分組邏輯已完成修正，所有技能都會依其實際路徑正確歸類到所屬群組。⟦猶如圖書館檔案室校正了索書號的辨識標籤，不再因為標籤上的斜線方向不同，就把總館的常備書籍誤標成分館專屬藏書。⟧
body.en: When viewing installed skills on Windows, categories and groupings in the panel are now much more accurate. Previously, when opening the `/skills` panel on Windows, host path separators (the backslash `\`) caused global and workspace skills to be misclassified due to path-matching issues. The path-matching and grouping logic has now been corrected so that all skills are properly sorted into their respective groups based on their actual paths. ⟦It is like a library archive fixing call number label recognition, ensuring books from the central library are no longer miscategorized as branch-exclusive items just because of the slash direction on the label.⟧

items.original: Fixed skill path matching and grouping in the `/skills` panel on Windows where host path separators (`\`) caused global and workspace skills to be misclassified.

title.zh-TW: 排除執行期重複授權與崩潰隱患，強化 `/boost` 與摘要處理穩定度
title.en: Fixed Duplicate Permissions and Runtime Crashes to Boost `/boost` and Summary Stability

body.zh-TW: 長時間執行多代理協作或重啟工作階段時，幾項影響執行階段與系統設定的底層問題已獲得修正。過去在重新載入工作階段與呼叫子代理時，設定檔會不斷累積重複的授權項目，現在已修正此累積現象。針對加速執行，改善了工作者工具配置以解決 `/boost` 在執行期失敗的問題。同時修復了背景摘要更新在軌跡關閉後因嘗試讀取快取步驟（暫存的歷史步驟）而引發的空指標嚴重崩潰。⟦這如同替工廠的自動化流水線做全面檢修，清除了多餘的重複通行許可並校準機具，還避免了抄表員在產線停機後誤查暫存紀錄而造成跳電。⟧
body.en: When running multi-agent workflows or reloading sessions over extended periods, several underlying runtime and configuration issues have now been resolved. Previously, reloading sessions or invoking subagents caused duplicate permission grants to accumulate in settings files, which has now been eliminated. For accelerated execution, worker tool configurations have been improved to prevent `/boost` from failing at runtime. Additionally, a fatal nil pointer crash caused by background summary updates attempting to read cached steps after trajectory closure has been fixed. ⟦It is like a complete overhaul of an automated factory line, clearing redundant access passes, calibrating machinery, and preventing inspectors from checking temporary records after line shutdowns to avoid power trips.⟧

items.original:
Fixed duplicate permission grants accumulating in configuration settings across session reloads and subagent invocations.
Fixed /boost failing at runtime by improving worker tool configurations.
Fixed a fatal nil pointer crash in the agent runtime caused by background summary updates attempting to read cached steps after trajectory closure.

title.zh-TW: 加固 Remote Control 反向通道路由，遠端連線傳輸更安全
title.en: Hardened Remote Control Reverse-Tunnel Routing for Safer Remote Connections

body.zh-TW: 從外部裝置遠端連線操控開發環境時，網路傳輸通道現在變得更加牢固。⟦這彷彿在總部與外勤特派員之間鋪設了加固的加密專用通道，並重新校準了路由方向，確保指令與數據往返時不會繞遠路或在中途受干擾。⟧Antigravity 提供的 Remote Control（讓使用者從遠端裝置操控本機對話的功能）依靠反向通道路由來轉發通訊；這次更新全面加固了反向通道路由的處理機制，大幅提升遠端連線時的連線穩定性與路由安全性。
body.en: When connecting from external devices to control your development environment, network transmission channels are now significantly more resilient. ⟦It is like laying a reinforced, encrypted dedicated conduit between headquarters and field operatives while recalibrating routing directions, ensuring instructions and data travel without detours or outside interference.⟧ Antigravity's Remote Control feature relies on reverse-tunnel routing to forward communication. This update hardens the reverse-tunnel routing mechanism, substantially improving connection stability and routing security during remote sessions.

items.original: Hardened Remote Control reverse-tunnel routing.

title.zh-TW: `/mcp` 面板導覽更順手，方向鍵與退出鍵分工分明
title.en: Smoother `/mcp` Panel Navigation with Clear Arrow and Escape Key Roles

body.zh-TW: 你在 `/mcp` 面板裡挑選 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與外掛時，方向鍵的職責現在劃分得一清二楚。上下方向鍵專門在各個伺服器與外掛項目之間縱向移動，左右方向鍵負責循環切換該項目的可用動作，按下 `Esc` 鍵便能退出動作模式或關閉面板。⟦這有如操作電視選單，上下鍵負責挑頻道，左右鍵切換音軌或畫質選項，按返回鍵就乾脆退回上一層，不會按錯鍵就亂跳欄位。⟧
body.en: When navigating MCP (protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers and plugins in the `/mcp` panel, the roles of arrow keys are now clearly divided. Up and down arrow keys strictly move vertically between individual servers and plugins, left and right arrow keys cycle through available actions for the selected item, and pressing `Esc` exits action mode or closes the panel. ⟦It is like navigating a TV menu: up and down keys switch channels, left and right keys adjust audio tracks or video quality, and pressing back cleanly returns to the previous level without accidentally jumping across unrelated fields.⟧

items.original: Improved `/mcp` panel navigation so up and down arrow keys strictly navigate between MCP servers and plugins, left and right arrow keys cycle available actions, and `Esc` exits action mode or the panel.

title.zh-TW: `/agents` 選單自動去重，跨來源不再冒出重複代理
title.en: Automatic Deduplication in `/agents` Picker Eliminates Duplicate Agents Across Sources

body.zh-TW: ⟦當不同部門的通訊錄都登記了同一個聯絡人，聰明的手機只會合併顯示一次，而不是在選單列出一長串分身。⟧當你在多個設定來源或外掛中定義了同名代理（agent，替你執行特定任務的 AI 助手），打開 `/agents` 選單時不會再看見重複項目的干擾了。過去系統在探索時，只要從不同設定來源或外掛發現同名代理，就會把每一筆都重複列在挑選器中；現在選單已經會自動去重，確保清單乾淨清爽。
body.en: ⟦When contact books across different departments list the exact same person, a smart phone merges them into a single entry rather than cluttering your list with duplicate profiles.⟧ When you define agents (assistants that perform specific tasks) with identical names across multiple configuration sources or plugins, opening the `/agents` picker no longer shows distracting duplicates. Previously during discovery, finding an agent with the same name across different sources or plugins listed every instance in the picker; the menu now automatically deduplicates entries, keeping your selection list clean.

items.original: Fixed duplicate agent entries appearing in the `/agents` picker when an agent with the same name is discovered across multiple configuration sources or plugins.

title.zh-TW: 啟動目錄失效也不怕，工具與代理初始化照常運作
title.en: Tool and Agent Initialization Succeeds Even from Deleted Working Directories

body.zh-TW: ⟦出門在外即使腳下的暫停點突然消失，只要隨身手冊記的是完整全球座標，導航就能照常運作。⟧就算你在一處已被刪除或無法存取的工作目錄中啟動命令列，工具初始化與代理啟動程序也不會再莫名崩潰。以前系統在處理記憶體中的參數架構時，會因目錄失效而找不到相對參照；現在全面改用絕對 URI（統一資源識別碼，以標準格式標記位置的字串）格式，確保各項工具與代理在任何目錄狀態下都能順利初始化。
body.en: ⟦Even if your temporary waypoint disappears under your feet while traveling, navigation continues smoothly as long as your guidebook records full global coordinates.⟧ Launching the command line from a working directory that has been deleted or is inaccessible will no longer cause tool initialization or agent startup to crash. Previously, parameter schemas held in memory lost relative references when the directory was invalid; switching fully to absolute URI schemes ensures all tools and agents initialize reliably regardless of directory state.

items.original: Fixed tool initialization and agent startup failing when launched from an inaccessible or deleted working directory by using absolute URI schemes for in-memory parameter schemas.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式輸出不再卡死，子行程自動釋放管線
title.en: Headless CLI Invocations with Pipes Exit Cleanly Without Hanging

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像工人下班離開工地時主動鎖緊水閥，才不會讓水管一直通水而卡住後續的工程驗收。⟧撰寫自動化腳本時，你在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的背景執行模式）下透過管線接收標準輸出或標準錯誤，程式結束時不再無故卡死。過去背景派生出來的子行程會持續霸佔呼叫端的管線，導致主程式遲遲無法順利關閉退出；現在系統已在保留的串流上加上 `FD_CLOEXEC` 標記，在結束時徹底釋放所有管線資源。
body.en: ⟦It is like workers shutting off the main water valve before leaving a construction site, ensuring pipes do not stay pressurized and stall subsequent inspections.⟧ When running automation scripts in headless mode (background execution without a visual interface) with piped standard output or standard error, invocations no longer hang on exit. Previously, spawned child processes kept the caller's pipes open and prevented the main process from shutting down cleanly; setting `FD_CLOEXEC` on preserved streams now ensures all pipe resources are fully released on exit.

items.original: Fixed headless CLI invocations with piped standard output or standard error hanging on exit by setting `FD_CLOEXEC` on the preserved streams so child processes do not keep the caller's pipes open.

title.zh-TW: `mcp_config.json` 語法更寬容，註解與結尾逗號照單全收
title.en: Lenient `mcp_config.json` Parsing Supports Comments and Trailing Commas

body.zh-TW: 手動編輯工具設定檔時，你不必再為隨手寫下的筆記或多打的逗號膽戰心驚了。過去在 `mcp_config.json` 檔案中加入單行註解 `//`、多行註解 `/* */` 或是在結尾多留尾隨逗號，都會導致 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）設定解析失敗；現在解析器已具備更佳的容錯能力，能順利讀取帶有註解與多餘逗號的設定內容。⟦這宛如一位懂通融的表單審查員，看見備註欄旁的手寫附註或句末多點的逗號，能自然看懂填表內容，不再直接退件。⟧
body.en: When manually editing tool configurations, you no longer need to worry about quick notes or extra commas breaking your setup. Previously, adding single-line comments `//`, multi-line comments `/* */`, or trailing commas in `mcp_config.json` caused MCP (protocol connecting AI to external tools) configuration parsing to fail; the parser is now more forgiving and reads configurations containing comments and trailing commas smoothly. ⟦It is like an understanding form inspector who effortlessly processes notes in margins or accidental punctuation marks without rejecting the entire submission.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP configuration parsing failing when `mcp_config.json` contains single-line (`//`) comments, multi-line (`/* */`) comments, or trailing commas.

title.zh-TW: 刪除對話徹底清理，不再殘留孤立註記檔案
title.en: Deleting Conversations Thoroughly Cleans Up Orphaned Annotation Files

body.zh-TW: 清理舊對話時，本機硬碟空間現在會被收拾得乾乾淨淨。以前每當你刪除對話紀錄，系統雖然移除了主對話，卻常把關聯的註記檔案遺留在本機儲存空間中，隨著時間推移默默堆積成無用的孤立檔案；這次修正補齊了刪除邏輯，會在刪掉對話的同時自動清除對應的註記檔案。⟦就像撕掉牆上的舊海報時，順手把固定在四周的雙面膠殘膠刮除乾淨，不讓碎屑在牆角日積月累。⟧
body.en: When clearing old conversations, your local disk space is now kept completely tidy. Previously, deleting a conversation removed the main chat but often left associated annotation files in local storage, gradually accumulating useless orphaned files over time; the deletion logic has been updated to automatically prune matching annotations alongside the conversation. ⟦It is like removing an old poster from a wall and scraping off the leftover adhesive tape around the edges, preventing stray scraps from piling up in corners.⟧

items.original: Fixed orphaned annotation files accumulating in local storage when deleting conversations.

title.zh-TW: 目標執行中隨口提問，`/btw` 不再強行推進或亂叫工具
title.en: Side Questions via `/btw` No Longer Force Goal Progress or Trigger Unintended Tools

body.zh-TW: 在 AI 全力衝刺大專案的中途，你終於能安心插話問個小問題了。當你開啟 `/goal` 指令讓系統執行長期目標時，若中途打 `/btw`（順帶一提，用來向 AI 提出旁支問題的指令）插話發問，先前系統常會把這則閒聊誤當作目標的一部分強行繼續推動，甚至亂呼叫工具；現在兩者狀態已徹底拆開，插問只會解答當前疑問，絕不干擾進行中的主任務。⟦彷彿你在主廚埋頭做大菜時問一句鹽巴放哪，他轉頭答完就回歸料理，不會突然把鹽巴整罐倒進湯裡胡亂攪拌。⟧
body.en: While AI is actively working through a major project, you can now safely ask quick side questions without derailment. When running a long-term goal with `/goal`, asking a side question with `/btw` (by the way, a command for asking auxiliary questions) previously led to treating the tangent as part of the active goal, forcing unwanted progression and unintended tool calls; their execution states are now decoupled so side questions resolve your query without interrupting the main task. ⟦It is like asking a chef cooking an elaborate meal where the salt is: they answer and resume cooking immediately, rather than dumping the entire salt container into the soup.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/btw` side questions in conversations with an active `/goal` being forced to continue and making unintended tool calls.

title.zh-TW: 自癒不再把名字像的自製腳本改成官方指令
title.en: Self-heal stops taking over your own script that just looks like a hook

body.zh-TW: ⟦郵差看到門牌上有「三號」兩個字就把信投進去，結果那是「二十三號」；現在他會確認整個門牌號碼相符才投。⟧你自己留了一份備份檔叫 `usage-terse-mode-backup.py`，`usage` 的自癒功能卻把它認成自家的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），悄悄改寫成官方指令。原因是它只拿 `usage-terse-mode` 這串字去比對，名字含這幾個字就算數。移除那條路徑先修好，要求這串字前後得是路徑分隔符號、引號、空白或字串邊界，並且結尾是 `.py`。現在遷移邏輯裡另外四處判斷要不要覆蓋掛鉤指令的地方，也都改用同一套嚴格比對。
body.en: ⟦A postman drops the letter off because the plate contains "3", when the address is "23"; now he checks that the whole number matches before posting it.⟧ You keep your own backup named `usage-terse-mode-backup.py`, and `usage`'s self-heal treated it as one of its own hooks and silently rewrote it to the official command. The cause was a plain substring check against a marker like `usage-terse-mode`: any filename containing those characters counted. The removal path was fixed first, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary around the marker and a trailing `.py`. The same precise check is now used at the four remaining call sites in the migration logic that decide whether to overwrite a hook's command.

items.original: **Self-heal no longer takes over a user's own script that merely shares part of a hook's filename.** Both the hook-removal path and the migration path that keeps an installed hook's command current used a plain substring check against markers like `usage-terse-mode`, so a user's own script — say, a backup named `usage-terse-mode-backup.py` — matched and was silently rewritten to the official command. The removal path was fixed first, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary around the marker and a trailing `.py`; the same precise check is now used at the four remaining call sites in the migration logic that decide whether to overwrite a hook's command.

title.zh-TW: 英文單字不再被當成日文或韓文
title.en: Plain English words are no longer read as Japanese or Korean

body.zh-TW: 語言代碼是拿來標示介面該講哪種語言的短代號，`ja` 是日文、`ko` 是韓文。`usage` 判斷代碼時只看開頭幾個字母就算數，於是 `jargon` 被讀成日文、`koala` 被讀成韓文。另外幾種寫法也判錯：`zh_TW@variant` 因為沒有先去掉 `@` 後面那段而掉回英文；`zh-HK` 不像 `zh-TW` 那樣接受後面再加細分代碼。再查一輪還發現 `zh-Hant` 和 `zh-Hans` 有同樣的開頭比對問題，亂編的 `zh-Hantasy` 也會被當成繁體中文，而缺了 `zh-SG-` 這個開頭讓合法的 `zh-SG-x-private` 掉成英文。這段判斷在四個檔案裡各有一份，現在四份都要求開頭之後有明確邊界。⟦查字典時只憑前兩個字母就翻到某一頁，`jar` 開頭的字全被歸進同一欄；現在得把整個詞對完才算。⟧
body.en: A language code is the short tag that says which language the interface should speak: `ja` for Japanese, `ko` for Korean. `usage` matched those with an unbounded prefix test, so `jargon` was read as Japanese and `koala` as Korean. Other forms were misread too: `zh_TW@variant` fell through to English because the part after `@` was not stripped, and `zh-HK` did not accept further subtags the way `zh-TW` and `zh-Hant` did. A second pass found the same unbounded-prefix bug in `zh-Hant` and `zh-Hans`, letting a nonsense `zh-Hantasy` match as Traditional Chinese, and a missing `zh-SG-` prefix that dropped a legitimate `zh-SG-x-private` to English. This logic was duplicated across four files; all four now require a boundary after every prefix. ⟦Looking a word up by its first two letters alone files everything starting with "jar" in one column; now the whole word has to match.⟧

items.original: **Language detection no longer misreads plain English words as Japanese or Korean, or a made-up Chinese-script tag as a real one.** The `_normalize_lang` logic — duplicated across four files — matched `ja`/`ko` with an unbounded `startswith`, so `jargon` and `koala` were read as Japanese and Korean; a POSIX `@modifier` suffix wasn't stripped, so `zh_TW@variant` fell through to English; and `zh-HK` didn't accept further BCP 47 subtags the way `zh-TW`/`zh-Hant` did. A second pass found the same unbounded-prefix bug in `zh-Hant`/`zh-Hans` (letting a nonsense `zh-Hantasy` match as Traditional Chinese) and a missing `zh-SG-` prefix (dropping a legitimate `zh-SG-x-private` tag to English). All four duplicated copies now require a boundary after every prefix.

title.zh-TW: 終端機編碼不合就整段訊息不見的問題修好了
title.en: A non-UTF-8 terminal no longer swallows the whole message

body.zh-TW: ⟦電線只要有一小段接觸不良，整條走廊的燈都熄掉；現在那截線路獨立起來，其餘照明不受影響。⟧工作階段開始與送出訊息時各有一個掛鉤，終端機用 cp950 這類非 UTF-8 編碼時，它們寫出 JSON 沒有轉成安全字元，會拋出 `UnicodeEncodeError`，你整段訊息就此消失。現在輸出一律轉成 ASCII 安全的 JSON，寫入動作也包在 `try`／`except OSError` 裡。另一個問題在版本標記：四個讀取器用 `split` 拆字串，遇到被截斷的一行或無效位元組就卡住，壞掉的腳本因此永遠不被認定需要重裝；現在改用 `partition`，也一併接住 `UnicodeDecodeError`。還有精簡模式的附屬檔內容爛掉時，只要掛鉤版本沒變就不會重建，因為判斷方式只是看檔案在不在；現在改成驗證內容本身。
body.en: ⟦One bad contact in the wiring used to darken the whole corridor; that stretch is now isolated, and the rest of the lights stay on.⟧ When a terminal uses a non-UTF-8 encoding such as cp950, `usage`'s hooks wrote JSON without escaping, raised `UnicodeEncodeError`, and lost your entire message. Output is now forced to ASCII-safe JSON, with the write wrapped in `try`/`except OSError`. A second problem sat in the version marker: four readers used `split` and choked on a truncated line or invalid bytes, so a broken installed script was never recognized as needing reinstalling; they now use `partition` and also catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. And when a terse-mode sidecar's content had rotted, it was never rebuilt as long as the hook version was unchanged, because staleness was checked with a plain `exists()`; it is now checked by validating the sidecar's content.

items.original: **A non-UTF-8 terminal no longer crashes terse mode or session resume, and a truncated or corrupted version marker no longer wedges self-heal.** The SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks wrote JSON without `ensure_ascii`, so a terminal using an encoding like cp950 raised `UnicodeEncodeError` and lost the entire message; output is now forced to ASCII-safe JSON with the write wrapped in `try`/`except OSError`. The four version-marker readers used `split` and choked on a truncated line or invalid bytes, which meant a broken installed script was never recognized as needing reinstalling; they now use `partition` and also catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. Separately, a stale terse-mode sidecar whose content had rotted was never rebuilt as long as the hook version hadn't changed, because staleness was checked with a plain `exists()`; it's now checked by validating the sidecar's content.

title.zh-TW: 續接提示不再因為一個小錯就整段消失
title.en: The resume prompt no longer vanishes over one small failure

body.zh-TW: ⟦一台機器只要有一個零件卡住就整台停擺；現在那個零件卡住時會單獨跳掉，機器照跑。⟧續接工作階段時 `usage` 會給你一段提示，講你上次做到哪。以前這段提示很容易整個不見：讀取標準輸入遇到管線斷掉會拋 `OSError`，但續接不像精簡模式那樣接住它，一個輸入輸出的小狀況就讓掛鉤當掉而不是正常結束。解析工作階段紀錄只接住 `OSError`，沒接 `UnicodeDecodeError`，紀錄裡有無效的 UTF-8 位元組時整段提示就消失，不會像遇到空紀錄那樣退回上一份還能用的舊紀錄。現在這兩種狀況都接住了，續接提示照樣出現。
body.en: ⟦One jammed part used to stop the entire machine; now that part trips on its own and the machine keeps running.⟧ When you resume a session, `usage` gives you a prompt saying where you left off, and that prompt used to disappear whole. `_read_stdin_utf8()` could raise `OSError` on a broken pipe and, unlike terse mode and the terse reminder, session resume did not catch it, so an I/O hiccup crashed the hook instead of exiting 0. `_parse_session()` caught `OSError` but not `UnicodeDecodeError`, so a session log with invalid UTF-8 bytes made the whole resume prompt vanish instead of falling through to the next older, valid log the way an empty log already did. Both are now caught, and the resume prompt still appears.

items.original: **Session resume's stdin and stdout failures are handled the same way its sibling hooks already were, and a corrupted newest session log falls back to an older one instead of going silent.** `_read_stdin_utf8()` could raise `OSError` on a broken pipe, and unlike terse mode and the terse reminder, session resume didn't catch it — an I/O hiccup crashed the hook instead of exiting 0. Separately, `_parse_session()` caught `OSError` but not `UnicodeDecodeError`, so a session log with invalid UTF-8 bytes made the whole resume prompt disappear instead of falling through to the next older, valid log the way an empty log already did.

title.zh-TW: 全部做完的待辦清單會清掉，只回一個標點不算數
title.en: A finished todo list gets cleared, and a lone punctuation reply does not count

body.zh-TW: 上次的事情都做完了，下次續接時提示還在報那些已完成的工作。續接掛鉤只有在新清單非空時才覆蓋舊的，而一次工作階段最後那筆 `TodoWrite`，也就是把每項都標成完成、留下空清單的那一筆，就被忽略了。現在全部項目標記完成後，清單會被清掉。同一批還修了三件事。健康檢查提醒存去重狀態時碰上磁碟滿了或權限不足，錯誤會往外冒把續接提示一起吞掉；現在用 `contextlib.suppress(OSError)` 框住。判斷回覆有沒有實質內容時，只要文字裡有標點就算數，`ok.` 或 `/clear` 這種短回覆因此被留下；現在要求標點兩側都得有字母或數字。另外，`git status` 給未追蹤目錄的路徑帶著結尾斜線，取檔名得到空字串被默默丟掉，剛建好還沒提交的資料夾因此沒出現在未提交清單裡。⟦清單上每格都打了勾，整張才收走；旁邊只畫了一撇的那格不算填過。⟧
body.en: Everything from last time was finished, yet the next resume prompt kept reporting that work. The resume hook only overwrote its stored todo list when the new one was non-empty, so the last `TodoWrite` call of a session — the one that marks everything complete, leaving an empty list — was ignored. A todo list is now cleared once every item on it is marked done. Three more fixes landed alongside it. Saving the health-check reminder's dedup state could raise `OSError` on a full disk or a permissions error, and that exception propagated far enough to swallow the main resume prompt; it is now scoped with `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`. `_has_structural_signal` treated any punctuation anywhere in the text as a sign of real content, so short replies like `ok.` or `/clear` were kept as if they were substantive; it now requires alphanumeric characters on both sides of the mark. And `git status`'s trailing slash on an untracked directory path made `basename` return an empty string, which was silently dropped, so a brand-new uncommitted folder never appeared in the uncommitted-work summary. ⟦Only when every box on the sheet is ticked does the sheet get taken away; a stray stroke beside a box does not count as filled in.⟧

items.original:
**A todo list is now cleared once every item on it is marked done.** The resume hook only overwrote its stored todo list when the new one was non-empty, so the last `TodoWrite` call of a session — the one that marks everything complete, leaving an empty list — was ignored, and the next session's resume prompt kept reporting work that was already finished.
**The health-check reminder's own state write no longer takes the whole resume prompt down with it, a bare punctuation reply is no longer read as a real request, and a newly created but uncommitted directory now shows up in the "not saved yet" list.** Saving the health-check reminder's dedup state could raise `OSError` (a full disk, a permissions error) and that exception propagated out far enough to swallow the main resume prompt along with it; it's now scoped with `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`. Separately, `_has_structural_signal` treated any punctuation anywhere in the text as a sign of real content, so short replies like `ok.` or `/clear` were kept as if they were substantive; it now requires alphanumeric characters on both sides of the mark. And `git status`'s trailing slash on an untracked directory path made `basename` return an empty string, which was silently dropped, so a brand-new uncommitted folder never appeared in the uncommitted-work summary.

title.zh-TW: 額度回復的通知回來了，一開啟就超標也會提醒
title.en: The quota-restored notification is back, and a first reading past the threshold warns

body.zh-TW: ⟦油表警示燈只要指針稍微晃回來就自己熄掉，等真的加滿油了反而沒有任何提示；而上車時油量本來就見底，它也一聲不吭。⟧額度用完後回復時，`usage` 應該通知你，實際上這則通知一直沒出現。原因是任何低於 100% 的讀數都會把「曾經用完」這個記號清掉，不管跌幅多小；等到真正的重置被認出來，記號早就被先前的小波動清掉了。那個重置指的是一次夠大的單步下降，用來跟雜訊區分開。現在只有那個重置判斷本身會清掉它。另外，警告門檻以前只能靠跟前一筆讀數比較才跨得過去，所以第一次觀測就已經超過門檻的情況完全不會警告，例如程式在你的工作階段進行到 95% 時才啟動。這不像用完的通知，那個第一次讀到 100% 就一定會發。
body.en: ⟦A fuel warning light that goes out the moment the needle twitches back says nothing when the tank is actually refilled, and stays silent when you get in with the tank already low.⟧ `usage` is supposed to tell you when depleted quota comes back, and that notification never fired. Any reading below 100% cleared the "was depleted" flag, regardless of how small the drop was, so by the time a genuine reset was detected — a single-step drop large enough to distinguish a real period rollover from noise — the flag had already been cleared by an earlier, tiny fluctuation. It is now cleared only by that same reset detection. Separately, a warning threshold could only be crossed relative to a previous reading, so quota that was already above the threshold on the very first observation — the app launching mid-session at 95%, for instance — produced no warning at all, unlike the depleted notification, which always fires on a first reading of 100%.

items.original: **The quota-restored notification fires again, and a warning now fires on the very first reading if quota is already past the threshold.** Any reading below 100% cleared the "was depleted" flag, regardless of how small the drop was, so by the time a genuine reset was detected — a single-step drop large enough to distinguish a real period rollover from noise — the flag had already been cleared by an earlier, tiny fluctuation, and the restored notification never fired. It's now cleared only by that same reset detection. Separately, a warning threshold could only be crossed relative to a previous reading, so quota that was already above the threshold on the very first observation — for instance, the app launching mid-session at 95% — produced no warning at all, unlike the depleted notification, which always fires on a first reading of 100%.

title.zh-TW: 系統匣選單不再被一個讀取失敗整個拖垮
title.en: One registry read failure no longer takes down the tray menu

body.zh-TW: Windows 上點開選單列的圖示，整個系統匣選單可能整個壞掉打不開。壞的其實只有一列：畫「開機時啟動」那個勾選框時，程式要去讀登錄檔（registry，Windows 存放系統與程式設定的資料庫）確認狀態，而它只接住找不到檔案這一種錯誤。權限不足時錯誤就往外冒，整份系統匣選單跟著垮。現在它接住所有 `OSError`，那一列直接顯示為未啟用。同一批也清掉一個沒有作用的設定鍵 `StartDelay`。`launchd.plist(5)` 根本不認得它，從加進去那天起就沒起過任何作用。⟦儀表板上一顆燈的線路壞了，整片儀表就黑掉；現在那顆燈只顯示未亮，其他讀數照常。⟧
body.en: On Windows, clicking the menu bar icon could leave the whole tray menu broken. Only one row was actually at fault: to draw the "launch at login" checkbox, the app reads the registry, the database where Windows keeps system and program settings, and its `is_enabled()` caught only `FileNotFoundError`. A registry permission error therefore propagated out and could break the whole tray menu instead of just that one row; it now catches any `OSError` and reports "not enabled." The same batch removed a dead settings key, `StartDelay`: `launchd.plist(5)` does not recognize it, so it had no effect and was doing nothing since it was added. ⟦When the wiring behind one dashboard lamp failed, the entire panel went dark; now that lamp simply shows unlit and the other readings stay up.⟧

items.original: **A dead plist key was removed, and a Windows registry read failure can no longer take down the whole tray menu.** `StartDelay` isn't a key `launchd.plist(5)` recognizes, so it had no effect and was doing nothing since it was added; it's gone. Separately, the Windows login-item's `is_enabled()` caught only `FileNotFoundError`, but it's called once per menu render to draw the "launch at login" checkbox — a registry permission error there propagated out and could break the whole tray menu instead of just that one row; it now catches any `OSError` and reports "not enabled."

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式的白話規則也管到子代理貼過來的字
title.en: Terse mode's plain-language rule now covers text pasted from a subagent

body.zh-TW: ⟦導遊全程用大家聽得懂的話講解，換成當地人代講那段時卻整段原話照搬，聽眾一下子跟丟；現在那段也要用同樣的說法轉述。⟧精簡模式（terse mode）要求把話講白，但這條規則以前只管 Claude 自己寫的句子。子代理的回報、工具的原始輸出被直接引用時，模式的提示裡沒有任何指示，裡面的術語就這樣原封不動貼出來，沒人解釋。現在在既有的「術語第一次出現時要解釋」那條規則後面加了一行，五種語言都加了。
body.en: ⟦A guide explains everything in words the group follows, then quotes a local speaker verbatim for one stretch and loses the group; now that stretch has to be relayed in the same plain words.⟧ Terse mode asks for plain language, but the rule used to govern only sentences Claude wrote itself. When a subagent's report or a tool's raw output was quoted directly, the mode's own prompt gave no instruction for it, so jargon inside went unexplained. A line was added after the existing "explain a term on first use" rule, in all five languages.

items.original: **Terse mode's plain-language rule now also covers text pasted verbatim from a subagent.** The mode's own prompt only governed sentences Claude wrote itself, leaving no instruction for handling a subagent's report or a tool's raw output when quoted directly — jargon inside it went unexplained. A line was added after the existing "explain a term on first use" rule, in all five languages.

title.zh-TW: Grok CLI 也有自己的用量狀態列了
title.en: Grok CLI gets its own usage status line

body.zh-TW: ⟦餐廳新開一家分店，總部把同一套點餐看板裝上去；撤店時也會把店家原本掛的那塊招牌放回原位，不是空著就走。⟧Grok CLI 支援跟 Claude Code 一樣的狀態列（statusLine，顯示在終端機最底下的資訊列）機制，所以 `usage_statusline_grok.py` 加進了既有的安裝／移除／自癒流程，用的是本來就跟 Claude Code 和 Antigravity 共用的那個開關。Grok 從標準輸入送進來的資料裡沒有用量摘要，官方文件明講了，所以腳本改去讀 `~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl` 裡的 `creditUsagePercent` 與 `currentPeriod.end`；兩者都讀不到就整段不顯示，不會印出佔位符號。只顯示週的軸線。Grok 沒有 5 小時視窗，也不回報快取命中率，兩者都不會拿去推估。
body.en: ⟦A restaurant chain opens a new branch and fits it with the same order board; when the branch closes, the owner's original sign goes back up rather than being left bare.⟧ Grok CLI supports the same command-style status line mechanism as Claude Code, so `usage_statusline_grok.py` joins the existing install / remove / self-heal flow behind the switch already shared with Claude Code and Antigravity. Grok's stdin payload carries no rate-limit summary — its documentation says so explicitly — so the script tails `~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl` for `creditUsagePercent` and `currentPeriod.end`; when neither can be read the segment is omitted rather than printed as placeholder characters. Only the weekly axis is shown, since Grok has no 5-hour window and reports no cache hit ratio, and neither is estimated.

items.original: **Grok CLI now gets its own `usage` status line.** Grok CLI supports the same command-style status line mechanism as Claude Code, so `usage_statusline_grok.py` joins the existing install / remove / self-heal flow behind the switch already shared with Claude Code and Antigravity. Grok's stdin payload carries no rate-limit summary (its documentation says so explicitly), so the script tails `~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl` for `creditUsagePercent` and `currentPeriod.end`; when neither can be read the segment is omitted rather than printed as placeholder characters. Only the weekly axis is shown — Grok has no 5-hour window and reports no cache hit ratio, and neither is estimated.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列第二行看得到快取命中率與到期倒數
title.en: The status line's second row shows cache hit rate and a countdown

body.zh-TW: Claude Code 2.1.251 在狀態列掛鉤從標準輸入收到的資料裡加了一個 `prompt_cache` 物件，`usage` 本來就把整包資料存進 `usage-status.json`，只是沒去讀它。現在第二行會顯示快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）命中率與到期倒數。新的 `color_by_pct_inverted()` 把配色門檻反過來，91% 的命中率讀起來是好事，不會借用額度那套紅色。`caching_observed` 不是 `True` 或比率讀不到時整段跳過，舊版 Claude Code 就安靜地不顯示；`expires_at` 過期只掉倒數、留下長條。終端機太窄還會再降兩級：先拿掉倒數，再整段收起來。⟦儀表板空間不夠時先收掉次要讀數，再收整組，而不是把數字硬擠成一團。⟧
body.en: Claude Code 2.1.251 added a `prompt_cache` object to the status line hook's stdin JSON, and `usage` was already storing the whole payload in `usage-status.json` without reading it. The second row now shows the prompt cache hit rate and a countdown to expiry. A new `color_by_pct_inverted()` mirrors the thresholds, so a 91% hit rate reads as good instead of borrowing the quota palette's red, and `progress_bar()` takes an optional `color_func`, leaving existing callers unchanged. The segment is skipped entirely when `caching_observed` is not `True` or the ratio is unavailable, so older Claude Code versions silently omit it; an expired `expires_at` drops only the countdown and keeps the bar. Narrow terminals degrade in two further steps: the countdown goes first, then the whole segment. ⟦When a dashboard runs out of room it drops the secondary reading first, then the whole cluster, rather than cramming the figures together.⟧

title.zh-TW: 別人的同名狀態列腳本不再被當成自己的接管
title.en: A third-party status line with a similar name is no longer taken over

body.zh-TW: ⟦倉庫管理員看到箱子上有「電池」兩個字就當成自家貨收走，其實那是「電池測試儀」；現在他核對整組品名相符才動手。⟧判斷一個掛鉤是不是自家的，以前靠 `"usage-statusline" in cmd` 這種部分比對，所以別人的 `usage-statusline-pro.py` 被當成 `usage` 裝的：沒備份就被接管，解除安裝時連他的設定一起刪掉。現在比對完整檔名，這個名字從 `HOOK_TARGET.name` 與同層檔案推出來，不再寫死字串，並要求名字兩側是路徑分隔符號、引號、空白或字串邊界。它刻意不比對完整路徑——指令字串會隨直譯器位置、引號寫法和 Windows 的反斜線改變，拿路徑比對反而會讓 `usage` 認不出自己。
body.en: ⟦A warehouse keeper hauls off a box because it says "battery", when the label reads "battery tester"; now the whole product name has to match before anything moves.⟧ Hook ownership was decided by the substring test `"usage-statusline" in cmd`, so someone else's `usage-statusline-pro.py` was treated as a `usage` installation: taken over without a backup, and its configuration deleted on uninstall. The comparison now matches the complete filename, derived from `HOOK_TARGET.name` and its siblings instead of a hardcoded string, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary on each side. It deliberately does not compare full paths: the command string shifts with interpreter location, quoting, and Windows backslashes, and a path comparison would stop `usage` recognizing itself.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列的檔案鎖改成等一段時間就放行
title.en: The status line's file lock times out instead of hanging

body.zh-TW: 你每送出一則訊息，狀態列就卡住不動——因為有另一個處理程序抓著同一把鎖不放。`_exclusive_lock()` 的 POSIX 分支用的是 `flock(LOCK_EX)`，會一直等下去；Windows 分支早就有 10 秒的 `_LOCK_TIMEOUT_S` 保護。現在 POSIX 分支改用 `LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB` 輪詢，等超時就走 `msvcrt` 那條路：不拿鎖，直接做原子寫入。⟦公共洗衣機的門鎖若只等前一位用完，隊伍就一路停住；現在等一段時間仍沒動靜，就照安全程序自己開門。⟧
body.en: Every message you sent left the status line stalled, because another process was holding the same lock. `_exclusive_lock()`'s POSIX branch used a plainly blocking `flock(LOCK_EX)`, while the Windows branch already had a 10-second `_LOCK_TIMEOUT_S` guard. The POSIX branch now polls with `LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB` and, on timeout, follows the `msvcrt` path: the atomic write proceeds without the lock. ⟦If a shared laundry room's door lock only ever waits for the previous user, the queue stops dead; now, after a set wait with no movement, it opens under the safe procedure.⟧

items.original: **The status line's file lock now times out instead of hanging a message.** `_exclusive_lock()`'s POSIX branch used a plainly blocking `flock(LOCK_EX)` while the Windows branch already had a 10-second `_LOCK_TIMEOUT_S` guard, so a process holding the lock stalled the status line on every message. The POSIX branch now polls with `LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB` and, on timeout, follows the `msvcrt` path: the atomic write proceeds without the lock.

title.zh-TW: 已安裝的狀態列副本真的會跟著更新了

body.zh-TW: ⟦門市貼的價目表只在總表改版號時才換新，改了價卻忘了改版號，門市就一直掛著舊價。⟧`needs_update()` 拿 `~/.claude/usage-statusline.py` 裡的 `__version__` 跟 `HOOK_VERSION` 比，兩邊一樣就跳過複製。所以出貨時沒有跟著調版本號的畫面改動，永遠傳不到你已安裝的那份副本，而且過程無聲無息、不報任何錯。現在兩個常數都調高了，也補上一個偏移測試——Token Saver 掛鉤本來就有這道防護，只有狀態列漏了。
body.en: ⟦A shop's price board is only reprinted when the master list's revision number changes, so a price that moved without a new revision leaves the shop showing the old figure.⟧ `needs_update()` compares `__version__` in `~/.claude/usage-statusline.py` against `HOOK_VERSION` and skips the copy when they match, so rendering changes that shipped without a version bump never reached an installed copy, silently and with no error. Both constants were bumped, and a drift test was added: the Token Saver hook had that guard already; the status line was missing it.

title.zh-TW: 報表多了一項「一次過關率」，各模型分開比
title.en: The report adds a first-pass rate, compared across models

body.zh-TW: ⟦球隊除了看得分，也開始記「一次進攻就成功的比率」，同一批球員換不同打法時，這個數字看得出哪套順手。⟧報表的使用習慣區塊新增一張卡，量的是這段期間你有多少比例的回合沒被打斷、也沒有被擋下的工具呼叫，並依模型分開列。這是品質面向，不是又一個額度數字。兩個訊號都從 `~/.claude/projects` 讀出來：使用者那幾行的 `interruptedMessageId`，以及 `tool_result` 裡的權限拒絕字串，沒有任何語意上的推測。分母取使用者回合而不是助理訊息，因為一次來回會吐出十來則助理訊息，會把每個模型壓到 99.5% 以上。同一回合裡多次打斷只算一次。`<synthetic>` 這類角括號標記排除在外。被打斷的助理訊息常常還沒寫進磁碟就中止，查不出歸屬的訊號進未歸屬桶、不顯示，不硬塞給某個模型。最高與最低模型差距超過 15 分時，才會寫出那句洞察。

Both signals are structural, read from `~/.claude/projects`: `interruptedMessageId` on user lines, and permission-denial strings inside `tool_result` content; nothing is inferred semantically. The denominator is user turns rather than assistant messages, because a single exchange emits a dozen assistant messages and would compress every model above 99.5%. Multiple interruptions inside one turn count once. Angle-bracketed internal markers such as `<synthetic>` are excluded. Interrupted assistant messages are frequently aborted before reaching disk, so unresolvable signals go to an unattributed bucket and are not shown rather than being assigned to a model. The insight line is written only when the spread between the highest and lowest model exceeds 15 points.

title.en: The report draws a day-by-day curve and prints properly
